description: The CREO CoCr system by Globus medical is a modular high-strength Cobalt Chrome alloy thoracolumbar pedicle screw system intended for use in hight-force constructs and surgeries where increased stiffness is required. The system comes as modular head or preassembled heads with both threaded and non-threaded cap options. It is interchangeable with other modular CREO systems. Accepts both 5.5 and 6.0mm rod sizes.
